hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *skills/*/references/*) s="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/scripts/build-demos.mjs"; [ -f "$s" ] || exit 0; out=$(node "$s" --check 2>&1) || { printf "%s\nRun: node scripts/build-demos.mjs\n" "$out" >&2; exit 2; };; esac; }
